top_missing.gap: One typed command contract and corpus: schema, capability, enabler, receipt, dry run, MCP generation, object model, command batch. Today RUN_COMMANDS has 8 entries and each panel has its own enum, so actions, batch and model lanes reach almost nothing.

Timeline delivery machinery: explicit preview rendering and render state, proxies attached to media with a project toggle, offline placeholder and link-media commands, background peak, conform and seek jobs, default transitions, clip time remapping, persisted playhead, raw settings on media items, optical flow.

Prototype interaction gaps and Figma motion: conditional and media actions, drag, keyboard and controller dispatch, scroll and fixed children, state preservation, reaction authoring; StudioMotionTimeline is a schema id only.
